model.name: The system
model.description: Discovered by SD Lab's kalman_lna from the stocks' levels, with Orchestra's counters attached to its flows.

flows.name: bakery customers arrived + bakery customers ordered
bakery app orders + bakery customers joined line + orchestra events (customers, review.posted)
bakery customers gave up + bakery inspections passed
bakery orders taken (1) + bakery orders taken (2) + orchestra events (board, order.queued)
